desc:
Welcome to WORLD TOWER DEFENSE!

🌟 A unique take on the "Tower Defense" genre!
🏝️ Defend many lands across the world!
🪓 Explore several unique gamemodes!
🧨 More difficult than most other games, but with more unique features!

This is the updated version of the original World Tower Defense.
Features multiple Save Files. To receive your Data from the old game, select File 4 when you join!

❗ Currently presenting the DEMO version of the 2.0.0 Update!
The full version is currently being worked on, and shouldn't take too long to release!

WTD!
Check the in-game update log for update information!
Credits for any Music used can be found in the game!
Inspired by Tower Battles, and Battle Cats
